description: Extends the org preset local>infrabay/renovate (grouped Go minor/patch and GitHub Actions updates, pinned action digests, and the `# renovate:`-annotated *_VERSION tool pins in the workflows and the Makefile). This file adds the provider rules: the Kubernetes modules move only in lockstep with crossplane-runtime, which pins them, and the code generators stay on the versions that match that Kubernetes line.

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate:` in the Makefile (registryUrl for Helm charts such as Crossplane)

packageRules.description: k8s.io/* and sigs.k8s.io/* (controller-runtime, controller-tools) are pinned by crossplane-runtime; they move only together with it, never on their own
crossplane-runtime and the shared Crossplane APIs move together and need make generate; never automerge
